verdict.rationale: Cal.com lists payments as a core capability, and its app directory offers a PayPal app to "charge for your bookings." Its webhook triggers include BOOKING_PAYMENT_INITIATED and BOOKING_PAID, which shows payment is built into the booking lifecycle. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a Stripe integration, documentation of how per-event-type pricing and checkout at booking are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
